tax.text: His campaign says he co-sponsors a financial-transactions tax to fund public investments.
tax.quote: Adam co-sponsors the Wall Street Tax Act, which taxes high-volume financial transactions to curb speculation and fund public investments.

wages.text: He supports raising the federal minimum wage to $15 and backs legislation strengthening workers’ rights to organize.
wages.quote: I support the Raise the Wage Act, which would increase the federal minimum wage to $15 per hour

trade.text: He said broad reciprocal tariffs were illegal and that ending them would lower costs.
trade.quote: After months of uncertainty caused by his shifting tariff policies, this decision marks an important step toward lowering costs for those in our state and across the country.

debt.text: He introduced legislation intended to prevent Social Security benefit reductions tied to the Windfall Elimination Provision.
debt.quote: The Social Security Equity Act helps to keep many workers and retirees from experiencing benefit cuts due to the Windfall Elimination Provision (WEP).

housing.text: He supports increasing housing supply, especially in growing cities, to reduce the nationwide shortage.
housing.quote: and increase housing supply to reduce the shortage of housing nationwide, particularly in America’s growing cities.

schools.text: He says federal investment in public schools should increase substantially.
schools.quote: I believe we must drastically increase our investment in public schools.

safety.text: He introduced legislation to create grants for unarmed mobile crisis-response programs.
safety.quote: To authorize the Secretary of Health and Human Services, acting through the Assistant Secretary for Mental Health and Substance Use, to award grants

immigration.text: He cosponsored a bill creating a path to citizenship for DACA recipients and certain other immigrants.
immigration.quote: As an original cosponsor of the Dream and Promise Act, which would provide a pathway to citizenship for DACA recipients and Temporary Protected Status (TPS) holders

guns.text: Smith supports background checks, red-flag laws, restrictions on assault weapons, and other gun-safety measures.
guns.quote: We must enact gun safety measures to keep our communities safe.

abortion.text: He supports federal protection for abortion rights and has backed legislation to codify those protections.
abortion.quote: The right to abortion is a fundamental right—one that must be safeguarded in federal law.

gender.text: He voted against the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which would have required sex-at-birth rules in school sports.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

cannabis.text: He voted for the MORE Act, which would remove federal cannabis prohibition.
cannabis.quote: Apr 01, 2022, 12:31 PM | 117th Congress, 2nd Session Vote Question: On Passage MORE Act

health.text: He supports moving toward a single-payer health care program like Medicare for All.
health.quote: The Medicare For All Act represents an important step forward in improving our health care system by establishing a single-payer, health care for all program.

energy.text: He calls for an urgent transition away from fossil fuels and decarbonization across the economy.
energy.quote: We need to urgently transition away from fossil fuels and decarbonize all aspects of our economy.

voting.text: He says he is working to expand ballot access and has cosponsored voter registration and weekend voting legislation.
voting.quote: I am fighting to ensure all Americans have access to the ballot box

tax.text: Basler criticizes high gas taxes for raising transportation, food, and energy costs for families.
tax.quote: Combined with one of the highest gas taxes in the country, these policies raise transportation, food, and energy costs — and those costs get passed on to families through nearly everything they buy.

debt.text: In a candidate questionnaire, he agreed that government should cut spending to reduce the national debt.
debt.quote: The government has many redundant and wasteful programs that could be streamlined and more efficient. We have to live on a budget - the government should have to as well.

safety.text: Basler criticized state police-accountability limits, saying they hinder officers’ ability to fight crime.
safety.quote: Basler also criticized police accountability laws passed in Washington state that limit high-speed pursuits and raised the legal standard for use-of-force, saying they interfere with officers’ ability to fight crime.

immigration.text: He said borders should be secure and immigration should be orderly and legal, balanced with workforce needs.
immigration.quote: Our borders must stay secure to prevent unlawful incursions and criminal operations. Immigration must be orderly, legal, and balanced with the needs of farming, industry, and employment needs of U S Citizens.

guns.text: Basler strongly disagreed that more restrictive gun-control laws are needed for public safety.
guns.quote: More restrictive gun control laws are needed to protect public safety. Strongly Disagree

abortion.text: In a candidate questionnaire, he said abortion should be allowed when the mother's life is at risk.
abortion.quote: When the life of the mother is at risk

health.text: He said health care should be left to the states and suggested exploring alternatives such as health savings accounts and co-ops.
health.quote: Healthcare is not function of the federal government and should be left up to the states. Medicaid and Medicare should stay in place as people have paid into it but the government has shown that it cannot be trusted with our money. Other alternatives should be explored along with Health Savings Accounts and Co-ops.

energy.text: He said the Climate Commitment Act raises energy costs and that those costs reach families through other purchases.
energy.quote: The Climate Commitment Act may sound good, but in practice it is driving up the cost of energy while doing little to directly improve the environment.

voting.text: He supports requiring voter ID and says he will work to preserve eligible voters' access to voting.
voting.quote: I support every effort to require voter ID and I will work to make sure every eligible voter has access to voting without hindrance or intimidation.
